architecture: 11-64-64-32-10 MLP, GELU; Adam 2e-3, weight decay 1e-5, 500 full-batch epochs, MSE in z-space

training.sampler: Latin-hypercube sweep of the canonical Python engine, 1400 points per machine (seed 12345, mulberry32), each machine over its own ranges (cone-sec: css_mm 6 to 90, throw_mm 16 to 44, speed_rpm 180 to 560, feed_x63_mm 40 to 200, feed_m 0.7 to 2, ore_axb 30 to 110; cone-tert: css_mm 4 to 22, throw_mm 10 to 26, speed_rpm 220 to 600, feed_x63_mm 15 to 55, feed_m 0.9 to 2, ore_axb 30 to 110; jaw: css_mm 50 to 160, throw_mm 24 to 50, speed_rpm 180 to 380, feed_x63_mm 180 to 500, feed_m 0.7 to 1.6, ore_axb 35 to 110; cone-short-head: css_mm 4 to 16, throw_mm 10 to 22, speed_rpm 380 to 600, feed_x63_mm 15 to 45, feed_m 0.9 to 2, ore_axb 30 to 110; gyratory: css_mm 120 to 240, throw_mm 22 to 40, speed_rpm 100 to 200, feed_x63_mm 300 to 800, feed_m 0.7 to 1.4, ore_axb 30 to 110); ore_wi = clamp(8 + (120 - ore_axb) * 0.09, 8, 20); degenerate draws dropped; the held-out draw is an independent second Latin-hypercube draw of 480 points per machine (seed 67890)
